text:
Type: swivel tufted bowl accent chair
Use: vanity seating, accent seating, desk seating; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: glam, retro, modern
Materials: faux leather upholstery, button tufting, chrome gas-lift column and base
Colors: pure white, polished silver chrome
Shape: round scooped bowl seat with diamond tufting, adjustable height pedestal, round disc base, swivel, compact and sculptural
Feel: playful, bright, chic
Goes with: white or pastel walls, chrome, mirrors, pink accents; glam bedrooms or vanity corners

product.name: JC Home Pompei Adjustable-Height Round-Back Button-Tufted Swivel Accent Chair, Pure White
product.description: Contemporary swivel accent chair adds trendy style to any home or office Broad, high, round-shaped back with button-tufting and diamond-shaped accents Leatherette upholstery (durable vinyl) in white; wide disc-shaped polished-chrome base for stability Adjustable height and tilt for optimal comfort; 500-pound weight capacity; assembly required Measures approximately 26.8 by 24.8 by 32.5 inches (LxWxH)
